name: Plymouth and South West Devon Joint Local Plan
organisation-name: Plymouth City Council, South Hams District Council, West Devon Borough Council

housing-numbers.notes: Plymouth Policy Area includes Plymouth administrative area plus urban fringe. Committed housing includes completions 2014-17 (2705), under construction (901), and outstanding commitments (8523). Also includes allowances for student HMOs (397) minus demolitions (872).

housing-numbers.organisation-name: Thriving Towns and Villages Policy Area
housing-numbers.notes: Covers rural South Hams and West Devon including market towns and villages. Committed housing includes completions 2014-17 (1394), under construction (371), and outstanding commitments (3337). Includes Sustainable Villages allowance (550).
